描述_EN: two monochrome tapestry squares inserted in a linen ground cloth, from the same original set. the spaces between each medallion are occupied by geometrical vine leaves. the two identically decorated fragments feature a central motif of four grape leaves arranged in a cross, framed by a wide border of medallions. these are adorned with stylized grape leaves.
描述_ZN: 两块单色挂毯插在亚麻底布上，来自同一套原件。 每个奖章之间的空间都被几何形状的藤叶占据。 这两块碎片的装饰完全相同，中间有一个由四片藤叶排列成的十字架的图案，被一个宽大的边框所包围。 这些都是装饰有造型的藤叶。
时期: 埃及 罗马统治时期；拜占庭统治时期
